verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack documents Firstbase filing for or obtaining a federal EIN for a new company. The pack only says users can open a bank account 'without an EIN' and that non-incorporation users can enter an existing EIN for Loop. Those lines are adjacent banking claims and only hint that EIN acquisition might be handled, without stating it.

support.subject: As a founder, I can obtain a federal EIN for my new company through the platform
